confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Guangzhou price levels for July 2026; no live booking pages or current listings were checked. Restaurant and café anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies widely by district and booking platform. Cocktail and wine are bounded using beer as the local reference, since direct knowledge is weaker. The FX observation comes from a search-result summary attributed to the RBA exchange rates page, not from a direct page read.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Chinese tier-1 city price levels, using Guangzhou's typical restaurant, café and hotel pricing relative to nearby large Pearl River Delta and Chinese tier-1 cities. No single comparable city was used.
